(1) We present the first automatic schedule generator for Halide image processing pipelines that produces schedules that are performance- competitive with (and often better than) those produced by expert Halide programmers; and (2) We show how our schedule generator, which is built upon a new locality and parallelism analysis, can be used to generate schedules for a broad range of image processing pipelines that outperform state-of-the-art hand-optimized Halide code.

the design of high-performance schedules for image processing pipelines can be largely automated.

the Halide image processing programming model is sufficiently expressive that it allows for the automatic generation of performance-competitive schedules for a wide variety of image processing pipelines.
